notes: Councils/government rotation open-web find on tick 20261014T0215Z. Careers page lists experienced Civil Designer roles in Busselton and Perth and invites CV emails to recruitment@jdsi.com.au. email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not an application for your advertised Civil Designer vacancies. Your careers page invites a CV and cover letter for a career conversation, so I am introducing myself for a graduate or junior civil design and drafting path in Busselton or Perth.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and interstate work where relocation is agreed.

Your land development work on roads, earthworks, stormwater and subdivision servicing is the kind of civil documentation I trained for. I do not yet have commercial AutoCAD production or 12D Model experience, and I am not applying for the experienced Civil Designer roles.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. I would welcome being kept on file for a graduate civil designer, junior drafter or similar early career opening.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I would like to ask whether JDSi has room for a graduate civil designer or civil draftsperson in Busselton or Perth. This is a speculative enquiry rather than an application for your advertised Civil Designer vacancies. I am writing to recruitment@jdsi.com.au because your careers page invites a CV and cover letter for a career conversation.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). My CAD work so far is from study rather than commercial production drafting, and I have not used 12D Model.
From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and field engineer, reviewing drawings, doing inspections and keeping site and material records.

I live in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Busselton or Perth for the right early career civil design or drafting role.
I have attached my resume and cover letter and would welcome being kept on file for a graduate or junior drafting opening.
